items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Nadine, one of my sisters... Shirley's upstairs in the bathroom... Shirley and Nadine got together

ctx.x: Like I said, I skipped school. I went home at the noon break, when you’d just be going home for lunch or something like that. No, I just went home to stay. That was my intent, to go home and stay. When I got there, Nadine, one of my sisters, she tried to keep me from knowing that my older sister was upstairs, but my mother wasn’t. So I said, “What’s going on?” I was surprised to see her home too. “What’s going on?” “Shirley’s upstairs in the bathroom. Don’t go up there.” I said, “Okay,” knowing them and their…
